title: Your fairness may vary: Pretrained language model fairness in toxic text classification

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring group fairness using Equalized Odds (maximum difference in true positive and false positive rates) in binary toxic text classification, comparing model performance on text mentioning religious identities versus text that does not.
